summaryJa: 2026年2月（正確な日付は文書で伏せられている）、対象者はFBIの捜査員に対しMicrosoft Teams経由で面談を受けた。対象者は経済・金融の学士号を有し、その夜は約21:15 ESTに自宅に戻った。車で自宅の下り坂の車道に入った際、裏庭の樹木の下方付近に強く輝く赤い球状の光を目撃した。外に出てスマートフォンで撮影を始めた。家の中にいた別の人物が防犯カメラで対象者が車の横に立って裏庭を見ているのを確認し、外に出て一緒に観察した。赤い球は直径約1メートルで、中央にバスケットボール大の「白いプラズマのような」部分が見えた。観察中にその球は上方かつ左方へ移動し、上方に同じ外見の第二の球が現れた。二つの球は樹木の上を西方へ向かって滑らかにかつ静かに飛行し、高度と方向を変えながら連携して動き、最後に合体したか非常に接近して一つに見えた。観測の途中から離れていく様子はビデオに記録され、面談書類に添付されている。数週間後、対象者は西から東へ高高度で移動する白い小球（腕を伸ばして持ったダイム硬貨大に見える）を複数目撃したと述べた。
summaryEn: In February 2026 (the exact day is redacted), the interviewee was interviewed by FBI agents via Microsoft Teams. The interviewee, who holds a bachelor's degree in economics & finance, returned home at approximately 9:15 PM EST. While pulling into a downhill driveway, they observed a bright red spherical light hovering below the tree line in the middle of their backyard. They exited the vehicle and retrieved a phone to record. A person inside checked a security camera and saw the interviewee standing beside the vehicle looking into the backyard; that person then joined the outside observation. The red sphere was described as about one meter in diameter with a brilliant red color and a basketball-sized "white plasma" feature at its center. The orb moved up and to the left, and a second identical orb appeared above the first. The two orbs moved together westward above the treeline, changing altitude and direction, silent and moving smoothly in tandem (as if tethered or in formation), and ultimately merged into one or were so close that only one was visible. Video of the orbs as they moved away is attached to the interview document. A few weeks later the interviewee reported seeing several white orbs pass over the house from west to east at a much higher altitude, described as about the size of a dime at arm's length.
